nodes.description: Immutable constant prize amount of 0.05 ether used as the funding requirement in the constructor.
Public address array that stores every caller who invokes the prize function; written before the balance transfer.
Payable constructor that requires msg.value >= prize, ensuring the contract is actually funded.
Public function that records msg.sender, enforces msg.sender == tx.origin, then transfers the entire contract balance to the caller.
Caller-controlled address used both as the recorded friend and as the recipient of the full balance transfer.
Origin of the transaction used as an anti-bot authorization check, enabling tx.origin based access control.
External value transfer of the whole contract balance to msg.sender, executed after state mutation and gated only by a tx.origin comparison.

edges.reason: msg.sender is pushed into the friends state array, so caller-controlled data flows into persistent state.
The prize function writes to the friends state array via friends.push(msg.sender).
Invoking the prize function unconditionally reaches the external balance transfer to the caller.
msg.sender controls the recipient of the external transfer, making the call target attacker-influenced.
tx.origin is compared against msg.sender in the require statement, forming a tx.origin-dependent authorization check.
Execution of the prize function is gated by the tx.origin equality requirement, so the transaction origin influences control flow.
msg.sender must equal tx.origin for the require to pass, so the caller identity controls whether execution continues.
The constant prize is read in the constructor require to validate the funding amount.
